title: Issue #49 GES48120M250-500P identity report and read-only Modbus frames
summary: Owner identifies the white 12kW split-phase unit as GES48120M250-500P. Raw slave-1 FC03 replies at 0x7530, 0x7548 and 0x756A pass CRC and length checks. Battery voltage 51.5 V, SOC 65%, phase-A output 122.9 V and mains 122.7 V agree with the community protocol. No 0xC738/0xC739 model/class response is supplied; successful telemetry alone does not qualify automatic binding.
